title: festuca polymorpha var. rubra
intro: Festuca polymorpha var. rubra, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a species of grass that is widely distributed in the mountainous regions of North America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve sleep, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Red Fescue include calming and sedative effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal remedies for anxiety and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of Red Fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are still being researched for their potential health benefits.
